> Hi,
> Just to note that https://rkward.kde.org/ , does not
> appear correctly displayed.
> Can you have a look?
> Best Regards!
> Alfonso

Thanks for reporting, not sure, why this broke.

I fixed the worst symptoms, but there may be some rough edges left. I
also had to flatten the navigation bar, as nested menus did not seem to
work any longer.

Should anybody wish to help, the repository governing this website is
at: https://invent.kde.org/websites/rkward-kde-org

(README.md for basic instructions).

Regards
Thomas
